summary: Master the art of foreign investment in real estate through expert-led training. Learn essential skills to navigate international property markets effectively.
lede: Foreign investment in real estate requires assessing cross-border property opportunities alongside ownership, market and transaction risks. For developers, investment analysts, finance teams, and legal, risk or public-sector professionals, the course covers evaluating market readiness, checking tenure and title issues, comparing deal structures, conducting due diligence, and stress-testing financial assumptions for tax, currency and repatriation risks.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who influence cross-border real estate decisions. It is particularly suited to those who need to understand and navigate the complexities of foreign investment in real estate.
audience: Corporate real estate and facilities managers
modules: Fundamentals of Foreign Investment in Real Estate
Market Entry Strategy and Investment Readiness
Land Tenure, Ownership Rules, and Title Risk
Legal and Regulatory Frameworks for Cross-Border Deals
Deal Structures That Attract Foreign Capital
Financial Modeling for Foreign Real Estate Investments
Tax, Currency, and Capital Repatriation Realities
Due Diligence That Prevents Deal Disasters
Communicating and Defending the Investment Case
Capstone: Build a Bankable Foreign Investment Deal Pack
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of real estate investment principles and familiarity with financial concepts. Experience in real estate development, finance, or investment is recommended but not required.
